title: Mask Email
prompt: An account page wants to hide most of a user's email address. Write a function that keeps the first character before @, replaces the rest of the name with three asterisks, and keeps the domain unchanged.

explanation.beginner:
Example: maskEmail("ada@example.com") produces "a***@example.com". The result must follow this precise rule: An account page wants to hide most of a user's email address. Write a function that keeps the first character before @, replaces the rest of the name with three asterisks, and keeps the domain unchanged. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “keeps the domain”: input ["person@sub.test.dev"] produces "p***@sub.test.dev". Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
